summary: This note is a wiki infobox for the fifth season of Vivo Pro Kabaddi, held in India from July 28, 2017 to October 28, 2017 and administered by Mashal Sports. The season used a double round robin, round robin and playoff format with 12 participants who played 138 matches. The Patna Pirates were the defending champions and won the season for their third title.
one_line: Infobox summary of the 2017 Pro Kabaddi League (season 5), held in India from July to October 2017 and won by the Patna Pirates.
key_facts: The 2017 Pro Kabaddi League was season 5 of Vivo Pro Kabaddi.
The season ran from July 28, 2017 to October 28, 2017.
Mashal Sports was the administrator of the 2017 season.
The tournament format was a double round robin, round robin and playoffs.
India was the host of the 2017 season.
The Patna Pirates won the 2017 season, their third title.
The Patna Pirates were the defending champions going into the 2017 season.
A total of 138 matches were played in the 2017 season.
The official website for the 2017 season was prokabaddi.com.
The previous edition was the 2016 season, held in June.
The following edition was the 2018 season.
